name: Shakkin Oukoku ~Love mo Money mo Full Charge~
original_name: 借金王国～ラブもマネーもフルチャージ～
source:
One cheerful morning the second daughter of the Sunrise Kingdom, whose father lovingly called her Cherry Blossom Sunrise, went to the mainroom as usual.

Waiting for her was a request from the king...

She needs to marry Prince Loan of the neighboring kingdom Aipool to pay back Sunrise's massive debts!

What, marry the infamous lover Prince Loan...!
Surely there must be another option.

Time to pull out all the stops to settle Sunrise's debt!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ083941.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个愉快的早晨，被父亲亲切地称为“樱花日出”的日出国二女儿，和往常一样来到了正厅。

等待她的是国王的请求……

她需要嫁给邻国艾普尔的洛恩王子来偿还日出的巨额债务！

什么，嫁给臭名昭著的情人贷款王子……！
肯定还有另一种选择。

是时候全力以赴偿还Sunrise的债务了！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ083941.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
